question: What body parts are injured most often on trampolines in 2024?
response:

Other frequently injured body parts included the head (about 10,049 estimated visits; 339 sample cases), elbow (about 7,521 estimated visits; 247 sample cases), lower arm (about 6,843 estimated visits; 273 sample cases), and foot (about 6,590 estimated visits; 198 sample cases). 

These are national estimates derived from NEISS hospital data. Product codes and injury definitions are recorded as categorized by the CPSC.
